title: Chapter 1866: Lifeless Lowlands (II)

Chapter 1866: Lifeless Lowlands (II)

The two Daoist Masters conferred quietly for a while before Shanbai looked up. "This method allows cultivators of lower realms to draw upon resources meant for higher realms, borrowing a fraction of the lifespan they would otherwise have gained through advancement. They can obtain a tenth or two of that additional lifespan, but lose any possibility of further breakthroughs.

"For instance, reaching the Foundation Establishment Realm would grant your elder another hundred years of life. Using secret techniques and spirit materials, we can simulate true origin within him and obtain a fraction of those years. If you are willing to spare a portion of Horn Wood spirit material and another of Valley Water or Pristine Water, we can harmonize them with our divine abilities. Combined with lifespan-extending pills suitable for his realm, we could try for twenty years. Anything beyond that would depend on his fortune!"

He had put it as delicately as he could. Li Ximing merely brought his hands together and sighed. "Just do everything you can!"

He took out the Horn Wood spirit material, [Late-Blooming Golden Branch], followed by a jade vial. Handing the vial to Xiangchun, he said solemnly, "I obtained this pill some years ago. It can extend lifespan. Please take a look, fellow Daoist."

Xiangchun took the [Heavenly Quintessence-Expelling Pill] and examined it closely. For a moment, she could not speak. Only after a long while did she carefully put it away and say in disbelief, "This is an exceptional pill... It was actually made with [Heavenly Origin Essence], and a considerable quantity at that. If you use this pill... it could extend his life by at least another ten years... But..."

She pressed her lips together. "It would grant a Purple Mansion Realm cultivator ten years as well. That is no small matter. Unlike a Qi Cultivation Realm cultivator's lifespan, theirs cannot be extended with just a little spirit material. If Xianyao and the others learned of this, they would offer everything they could to obtain it... Please think this through, fellow Daoist!"

Li Ximing sighed. "Would I have shown it to you if I hadn't already thought it through?"

Xiangchun exchanged a glance with Shanbai. After some thought, she said, "There is no hurry to use it. Twenty years is a considerable time. How about this... Shanbai and I will first tend to the elder's health and secure those twenty years for him. If the King of Wei acquires another suitable treasure or remedy during that time, we can discuss it then.

"As for this pill, I will also draw up a prescription for administering it in a specially prepared draught. But let's hold off on using it. Should it become necessary later, the elder need not feel guilty..."

Xiangchun clearly disapproved of such lavish expenditure, though she expressed it delicately. Li Ximing nodded silently. "Then I must trouble you both!"

Both waved away his thanks. Shanbai sighed. "You aren't the first to seek me out, Zhaojing... Some years ago, Fellow Daoist Tingyun also brought an old man here to have a persistent ailment treated... Those who wield divine abilities may stand far above others, but everyone has a loved one they cannot let go of!"

"Indeed..." Li Ximing raised his brows and asked, "Senior... what was the [Calamity of Severed Nourishment] you mentioned earlier?"

Shanbai paused and glanced at Xiangchun. Seeing her calm expression, he took his cue and said, "It was an event that happened during the first immortal-devil war.

"Conflict between immortals and devils never ceased, with three major wars in all. Much of Wood Virtue belonged to the Devil Dao, and suffered devastating losses in the first war. The True Monarchs of Gathering Wood and Transforming Wood both fell, leaving Wood Virtue in decline for a very long time. Later, due to divisions among the Dao lineages, only Horn Wood and Orthodox Wood flourished within Wood Virtue's Orthodox Dao...

"The spark that ignited that war was the [Calamity of Severed Nourishment]. There was a Dao of Wood Virtue called [Preserving Wood]. Though it was not particularly prosperous, its Principal Position was occupied by a Devil Ancestor who was an immortal, known as [Zixuan].

“His might was overwhelming, second only to the Three Profundities. He brought the [Calamity of Severed Nourishment] upon the Immortal Dao, grievously defying Heaven's majesty, then withdrew from the world. Preserving Wood's Fruition Attainment was heavily suppressed and never flourished again."

Shanbai lowered his eyes. "However, this is only hearsay. Take it as a story told for amusement. The [Calamity of Severed Nourishment] was terrifying... yet harmed not a single person. As for how insidious it was... nothing in all history could compare..."

Li Ximing frowned deeply. "How insidious could it have been?"

A bitter expression crossed Shanbai's face. "After the Three Profundities departed this world, no one could match that Devil Ancestor's Dao conduct. He held Preserving Wood's Principal Position and Banished Essence's Surplus Position. Pledging the entirety of his lifelong Dao lineage, his nature, his life, and his Order... he borrowed something from Heaven and Earth, secretly severed it, and hid it away."

Li Ximing asked, "What was it?"

"Lifespan." Shanbai sighed. "The lifespan of all living beings."

Li Ximing raised his brows and met Shanbai’s eyes. Meanwhile, Xiangchun looked to the side. "In those days, ordinary people lived a hundred and twenty years, shamans four hundred, and those with divine abilities eight hundred. Traces of this remain even now. Books still speak of mortals living a hundred years, but in truth, they decline at fifty, are spent at sixty, and die at seventy."

Li Ximing stood stunned, unable to speak for a long time. At last, he said, "How... vicious!"

Shanbai smiled bitterly. "Without such viciousness, how could he have become one of the four great figures who founded the Devil Dao? The [Lifeless Lowlands] he raised up was founded upon canonical invocations. Though ranked alongside the [Wuguan's Legacy], [Xuanxi Demonic Relic], and [Ancient Evil Dao], it was the most firmly established and powerful of the true Devil Daos!

"As long as the [Lifeless Lowlands] stands, [Preserving Wood] cannot reclaim its former name, nor can it be freed for anyone to attain its Dao!"

The old man's lineage clearly preserved records of these events, for he knew a great deal about Wood Virtue in that era. He continued, "Even after that Devil Ancestor attained the Dao and departed beyond this world, the [Lifeless Lowlands] remained hidden under the guardianship of his disciple, Devil Monarch Zheli. Several great figures still cherished their old ties with him and agreed with his ideals. In the end, the True Monarchs fought a battle, and a few of them fell. That was all.

"But that Devil Monarch remained hidden in the [Lifeless Lowlands], manipulating events and unleashing bloodshed time and again. He was even involved in the Battle of Pingming Ford... Only when the fighting brought down the heavens themselves was the debt finally settled..."

At his claim that the debt had been settled, Xiangchun quietly raised her brows. "If it had truly been settled... those years of life should have been returned!"

Li Ximing paused, then felt alarm rising within him. "So... Devil Monarch isn't a title one can simply adopt. In that case, the Lesser Yang Devil Monarch..."

Shanbai immediately fell silent. Xiangchun, however, sighed and answered openly, "The Lesser Yang Devil Monarch was a disciple of the [Purple Terrace Profound Pavilion Sect] and belonged to the [Ancient Evil Dao]. He had nothing to do with the [Lifeless Lowlands]. Naturally, he was a Devil Monarch under our great Tongxuan Dao!"

Shanbai grew visibly flustered. Touching his forehead, the old man interrupted, "I'll go prepare the spirit items!"

He hurried away. But the woman still wore a cold smile. Glancing around, she said evenly, "Why shouldn't it be said? [Wuguan's Legacy] belongs to Douxuan. Doesn't everyone still flock to it? The [Xuanxi Demonic Relic] belongs to Qingxuan, and their teachings also remain in circulation. The Three Profundities is the Great Dao of the Orthodox Beginning. Like the sea receiving a hundred rivers, they encompass even the Devil Dao. No one has ever denied it!"

Li Ximing inwardly grew solemn.

She's right... [Wuguan's Legacy] is indeed aligned with Douxuan Mountain!

Thinking it over, he had never encountered a [Preserving Wood] cultivator. Yet he did possess a [Preserving Wood] spirit treasure, the recently acquired [Heavenly Nurturing Urn]!

The inscription on its base was precisely [My Spirit Dwells in the Lowlands]!

No wonder [Grand Sacrifice] seemed nothing like an Orthodox Dao ability. Gathering blood essence and imprisoning those with divine abilities... it was a Devil Dao artifact all along.

The Song Emperor did mention that this Dao was incomplete and had been embroiled in some sordid affairs concerning its lineage. There must have been considerable turmoil afterward... What exactly were the immortal-devil wars fought over, to have left the entire world as it is today?

The order of immortals and devils... Fruition Attainments... Yin and Yang... or the Five Virtues and Twelve Essences?
